name: The Copper Circuit Bar
description: A sleek chrome bar where automatons come to lubricate their social circuits with motor oil cocktails. The bartender is a smooth-talking service bot who makes drinks with mathematical precision. Neon beer signs advertise brands like 'Electric Dreams' and 'Quantum Lite.' A jukebox plays synth music exclusively. Bar stools adjust to any anatomy (very inclusive). The bowl of nuts is actually just small screws and bolts. Happy hour is from 11:11 to 11:12 because binary.
